name: Constitutional Impact and Budget System
purpose: Convert modeled recovery into visible budget allocations, public program funding, and community-level reinvestment structure.
description: CIBS receives recovery value from CIRI and translates it into allocation logic that shows how recovered value can move into housing, mobility, legal aid, workforce participation, agriculture, community stabilization, and other public-facing priorities.

inputs.name: ciri_artifact
inputs.description: Recovery output including total recoverable value, cases avoided, jail days avoided, and restored participation.

inputs.name: budget_template
inputs.description: Optional template for category weighting and allocation structure.

inputs.name: auto_budget
inputs.description: Optional preset allocation or scenario structure.

outputs.name: available_budget
outputs.description: Total modeled budget available from recovery.

outputs.name: total_percent
outputs.description: Total percentage of allocation represented in the budget model.

outputs.name: program_count
outputs.description: Number of funded public-facing program categories represented.

state_transitions.description: Converts net recovery into budget availability.
Distributes recoverable value into visible categories that citizens can understand and communities can use.

citizen_value.plain_language_role: Shows where recovered value can go and how community uplift becomes visible rather than abstract.
